name: Kenco MCS Dallas I - DeSoto TX

fieldNotes.truckGate: Fully fenced perimeter with a controlled truck gate on the S/SW driveway off the I-35E service road. Confirmed in 2025-02 Street View and z20 satellite — chain-link perimeter fence, gated truck driveway with gate arms.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small 1-vehicle-footprint guard booth sits beside the gate driveway, visible in both z20 satellite and 2025-02 Street View.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Paved apron between the I-35E service road and the gate gives trucks room to wait outside the gate.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved truck court inside the gate before the dock doors.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron with twin landscaped islands and room for an express bypass lane.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock building: dock banks on both the N face and the S face — physically separate clusters.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock banks on both long faces of a ~458,000-490,000 SF e-commerce DC; banded 50+. Door count ~80 is an overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive striped trailer-parking drop yards on the W end and along the S side, well over 50 stalls.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Within the Dallas metro fabric along I-35E, immediately adjacent to dense residential; judged Urban.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~25 trailers counted in dock aprons / drop yards; drop yards largely empty in this imagery, approximate.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: ~160 estimated from the large striped W and S drop yards; low confidence.
